payout_quote: New customers can earn $250* by following these easy steps: Account must be opened between April 20 - September, 30, 2026. Offer available to new personal checking customers only. Set up reoccurring direct deposit and receive at least two direct deposits to your new account totaling $1,000+ within 90 days. A $250 account credit will be automatically issued within 30 days of qualification.
steps: Open a new YourWay Premier, YourWay Plus, or YourWay personal checking account online or in person between 4/20/2026 and 9/30/2026, entering promo code NEWCK2026 if applying online (new personal checking customers only; $10 minimum deposit).
Set up recurring direct deposit of payroll, social security, or pension (person-to-person and bank transfers do not qualify) and receive at least $1,000 total within 90 days of account opening.
A $250 account credit is automatically issued within 30 days of the 90-day qualification period; keep the account open until the credit posts.
catches: Offer available only to consumers residing with a physical address in Cumberland, Dauphin, Franklin, Fulton or Huntingdon County, PA or Washington County, MD.
Account owners who participated in an F&M Trust checking account offer within the last 24 months are not eligible; F&M Trust employee-owned or joint accounts excluded.
Account must be opened between 4/20/2026 and 9/30/2026 (YourWay Premier, YourWay Plus, or YourWay checking); online applications must enter promo code NEWCK2026.
Qualifying direct deposit = recurring electronic deposit of payroll, social security, or pension; person-to-person, bank transfers, or other electronic transfers do not qualify.
Bonus forfeited if the account is closed before the credit posts; account must be open with a balance over $0 at verification; bonus reported to the IRS.
Limit one qualifying account per account holder; primary holder must be 18+.
biggest_catch: You must live in one of five PA counties or Washington County MD — and no one who got an F&M Trust checking bonus in the last 24 months qualifies.

timing: $250 account credit issued within 30 days of the 90-day qualification period.
